meta.note: Ticket #58 layout probe. Twelve entries hand-picked from MULTI_TRANSCRIPTS for their LAYOUT shape, not their language: very different sizes, odd counts, same-type pairs, wide-beside-tall, and a flat image beside editable shapes. The mermaid is hand-written the way smoke-generated.json and demo-generated.json are, because #58 asks about placement and does not need an LLM to ask it.
